offering_description.value: Provides consumer and business credit reporting, identity verification, fraud prevention and risk analytics to lenders, insurers, employers, landlords and other businesses. Delivers data, scores and software through online platforms and direct integration with customer systems.

primary_products.value: credit reports; credit scores; identity verification; fraud detection; risk analytics software

primary_services.value: consumer credit monitoring; background screening; marketing data services; tenant screening; debt collection analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit card issuers, auto lenders, insurers, telecom and utility providers, employers, landlords, marketers; B2C: individual consumers buying credit monitoring and reports directly; B2G: government agencies using identity and fraud verification services

end_markets.value: financial services; insurance; healthcare; retail; telecommunications; real estate; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: consumer credit monitoring and identity protection plans paid by individuals; transaction or usage fees: per-inquiry fees for credit reports, scores and identity checks; service fees: background screening and analytics services billed to businesses; project or contract: custom data and software implementations for large clients
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: gathers consumer credit data and sells risk information to lenders and insurers; software / platform: provides analytics and verification software delivered to customer systems; service provider: performs screening, monitoring and marketing data services for businesses
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: operates in North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: consumer credit information, risk and fraud solutions, background screening, marketing data and identity services sharing data and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large financial institutions and enterprises; online: web and mobile platforms for consumers and small businesses; partners / resellers: integrations and reseller arrangements with software and data partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer reporting under FCRA, GLBA and state privacy laws, overseen by the CFPB and FTC
